evidence.title: Componentry — Beautiful Animated UI Components for React
Components Documentation | Componentry - UI Component Library

name: Componentry
summary: Animated React component library with editable source: text animations, scroll effects, hero backgrounds and image effects.
description: Componentry is a free, MIT-licensed collection of 53 animated React components and visual effects with copy-paste source code, built by Harsh Jadhav with TypeScript, Tailwind CSS and Framer Motion. Collections group text animations, scroll-driven interactions, animated backgrounds and image effects; components install through a shadcn CLI registry or the Componentry MCP server for Claude Code and Cursor.
contains: collections: text animations, scroll animations, animated backgrounds, image effects
install via shadcn CLI (@componentry/…) or copy-paste the source
MCP server for Claude Code, Cursor and other AI editors
WebGL effects: image ripple, liquid glass carousel, ripple transition, dithered logo
built with TypeScript, Tailwind CSS and Framer Motion; backed by Vercel OSS Program
